en.title: Most Times a Character Is the Most Frequent in a Prefix
en.description:
For each non-empty prefix of the original string, every character whose count reaches the maximum count in that prefix gets 1, including all tied characters. Find the maximum accumulated count of a single character.

The standard I/O, examples and solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: One line with a lowercase string, 1≤length≤100000.
en.explanation: Example 1: c is tied for or holds the maximum in prefixes 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8, 6 times in total. Example 2: z is the maximum in all 4 prefixes, so the answer is 4. Example 3: a is the maximum in both a and ab, while b is the maximum only in ab, so the answer is 2.
hints: Maintain 26 frequencies and accumulated counts; after adding each character, add 1 to every character tied for the highest frequency.
